historical_reviews.deepseek: Read-only retrieval is feasible, but an AssetTag may be product-, chassis- or OEM-scoped and the proposed full dump exposes unrelated identifiers.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Correctly adds object-scope, inventory, blank/replacement, privacy and status gates.

historical_reviews.v3_1: Requires the same asset-management object across FRU, UI and inventory; a syntactic field match is insufficient.

original_test_intent: Verify that the Product Asset Tag in the intended FRU is readable, correct and matches the same product-level asset tag in the BMC web UI.
original_method: Identify the managed product and tag authority, securely collect the scoped FRU and UI/API tag, protect raw asset identifiers, and compare under approved blank/replacement/normalization rules.
manual_activity: Supply the authoritative asset-register value, object-scope mapping and approved blank/replacement/redaction rules; no physical action is required.
required_inputs: Masking policy and protected evidence store
safety_requirements: Use read-only FRU and API operations
Never write FRU or issue PATCH/raw mutations
Do not expose passwords or unrelated identifiers
Do not substitute chassis or component tags without approved mapping
Stop on duplicate or ambiguous scope
agent_execution_scope: Bind the physical product and intended FRU
Resolve the authoritative asset register and UI/API object
Extract only the scoped asset tag

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: FRU readout can contain an asset tag, but `.Product.AssetTag` under the proposed chassis resource is not validated and may represent a different managed object. Full unredacted output is excessive.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use secure read-only queries for the bound product FRU and validated product-level UI/API tag, retain protected raw values and compare masked representations with the asset register.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The FRU-list inspection, Product Asset Tag focus, UI agreement criterion and 2/0-minute timing are preserved; scope and blank/replacement meaning are not guessed.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use an asset-object comparator with FRU/resource provenance, protected raw tag, register version and explicit blank/replacement state.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds asset-scope identity and privacy controls rather than relying on a guessed JSON path and visual confirmation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Distinguishes unassigned, stale, replacement and wrong-object tags while retaining the original read-only comparison.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: An empty tag may be valid or a defect depending on lifecycle state; only the asset owner can define that policy.

project_override_considerations: Product Asset Tag may differ from chassis or component asset tags. No equivalence is accepted without the project asset model, and private script contents are not inferred.
expected_evidence: Selected FRU and UI/API object provenance
No hardware PASS claim by the agent

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The Master consistently asks for Product Asset Tag and FRU/UI agreement. Missing object scope, inventory and lifecycle policy are normal prerequisites rather than contradictions.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The requested read-only comparison is defined; the asset-register, scope and privacy packages are finite owner inputs.

review_improvement: Prevents a chassis/component tag, missing-field fallback or unassigned value from being silently accepted as the product asset identity.
independent_technical_reasoning: AssetTag is operational inventory data, not a universally defined hardware identity. Product and chassis resources may legitimately carry different tags, and blank or replacement values require lifecycle context. Binding the same asset object and controlled register makes the check deterministic; the missing inputs are requestable, so the case is REQUIRES rather than BLOCKED.
